Namespace.description: Name of the package into which the Java types will be generated.

UnderscoreNames.description: Whether underscore names in types should be stated in client-code or writen in camelCase flavor.

WsdlUrl.description: WSDL Uri to generate the client from. Can also be a local file.

Map(String,WebServiceClientSchema).description: Web service clients by key. The key survives renames; it has only letters, digits, `-` and `_`, usually `Name` with spaces as `-`. `#` lines directly above a key describe the client.

Features.description: Full qualified class names, that contribute WS-client call features, such as authentication.

Properties.description: Properties that supply dynamic values for Webservice-client features.

LegacyId.description: Legacy ID of the web service client, only used for migration purposes and should not be set by users

username.description: The username used to authenticate on the remote web service

password.description: The password used to authenticate on the remote web service

NTLM.challenge.description: Whether to authenticate via NTLM by responding to auth-challenges (deprecated). Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.NTLMAuthenticationFeature

NTLM.domain.description: The Active Directory Domain to authenticate against (optional, deprecated). Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.NTLMAuthenticationFeature

NTLM.workstation.description: The workstation (host) of the computer originating the request (optional, deprecated). Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.NTLMAuthenticationFeature

SSL.keyAlias.description: The keystore key alias to use if the SSL connection to the web service is configured to use client authentication.

session.handlingMode.description: Defines how the session should be reused.OFF: No session handling is used.APPLICATION: Whenever the same service is invoked within an application, the existing session will be reused. In fact the cookies will be restored.

proxy.host.description: The name of the proxy server. Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.ProxyFeature

proxy.port.description: The port number of the proxy serverUsed by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.ProxyFeature

proxy.nonProxyHosts.description: A list of hosts that should be reached directly, not going through the proxy.It is a list of patterns seperated by "|". The patterns may start or end with a '*' for wildcards.Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.ProxyFeature

proxy.auth.scheme.description: The name of the autentication scheme used for the proxy server. Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.ProxyFeature

proxy.auth.username.description: The user name used to authenticate against the proxy server. Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.ProxyFeature

proxy.auth.password.description: The password used to authenticate against the proxy server. Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.ProxyFeature

use.async.http.conduit.description: Whether to use the 'org.apache.hc.client5.http.async.HttpAsyncClient' or not. Otherwise 'java.net.HttpURLConnection' will be used.

jakarta.xml.ws.client.connectionTimeout.description: Specifies the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the consumer will attempt to establish a connection before it times out.

jakarta.xml.ws.client.receiveTimeout.description: Specifies the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the consumer will wait for a response before it times out.

log.limit.description: Defines the maximum recorded characters, when logging input and output payloads.Values should not exceed 2147483647

endpoint.cache.description: Caching used webservice endpoints is a performance improvement. However, if you need unique feature instances you may disable this cache.

policy.disabled.description: A comma-separated list of policies to be disabled. A policy definition has the form 'namespaceURI:policy'. Used by the ch.ivyteam.ivy.webservice.exec.cxf.feature.policy.IgnorePolicyFeature

schema-validation-enabled.description: Xml schema validation of SOAP requests and responses
